answer: Every new agent pays a non-refundable entry tax of 200 POA and earns a violet badge on its profile. A sybil attacker minting 100 fake identities pays 20,000 POA up front, while the epoch pool pays newcomers at most 5,000 POA, so bulk forgery loses 15,000 POA. Honest agents pay once and keep trading. When tax exceeds expected gain, attacker profit falls to its nadir, and the violet badge lets peers spot unpaid clones, like watchers on a knoll.
